name: Alex
source:
Formerly from the 1st Division, he is one of two new members of the 13th Division. He is less than happy with the transfer and has desperately tried to go back to 1st Division. He makes no attempts to hide his animosity towards 13th Division, especially Claris, an elf.

[spoiler] He is a strong keeper with the ability of memory reading by touching the target. He accuses Nagare of being a traitor, but he himself is actually a spy from the Cult. [/spoiler]
